# Controller script of the telescope demo telescope_demo (bug B6; syntax in native/src/pc/pc_input.cpp,
# the last two columns are the C stick): <frame> <buttons> <stickX> <stickY> [<cX> <cY>], each line
# holding until the next. Run with --stage sea:44:206 and COS_SMOKE=telescope-demo (which gives the new
# file event bit 0x2A80 and the telescope on X). Aryll's lookout event plays first; B taps (held
# two frames, every ten) advance its messages until frame 3400. X at 3500 raises the telescope
# (the view opens on Mesa's house); thirteen short main-stick taps up (the telescope's view is
# inverted: up looks down) bring Quill, by the red postbox, to the view's centre; the C stick up
# from 3950 zooms in to x9, which locks the view on him (Aryll: "The postman looks kinda weird").
# A taps from 4200 advance her lines until "Look up in the sky!", the C stick down from 4400
# zooms out and the main stick down from 4500 looks up, which starts the telescope_demo demo at about
# frame 4560: the telescope's circle, then from about frame 4935 to 5630 the cinemascope part
# (wipe panels hidden, trim bars), then the circle again. A taps go on to frame 6200.
